faqs.question: What does GPSPL include under Audio Technologies?
faqs.answer: GPSPL includes professional audio systems, microphone technologies, meeting-room audio, classroom audio, AV-board solution support, installation, service and warranty extension planning.

faqs.question: Why is audio planning important in AV projects?
faqs.answer: Audio affects speech clarity, meeting reliability, classroom communication, conferencing quality and user confidence. A good display or camera cannot fix poor voice pickup or room sound.

faqs.question: How does GPSPL design an audio solution?
faqs.answer: GPSPL studies the room purpose, audience size, seating layout, voice pickup needs, conferencing use, existing infrastructure, installation constraints and support expectations before selecting products.

faqs.question: Which audio brands can GPSPL support?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can support project-fit professional audio systems including Harman/JBL, Sennheiser, HP Poly and Sony microphone or collaboration audio technologies depending on the room requirement.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL provide sales and service support?
faqs.answer: Yes. The brochure states that sales and service solutions are available for IT and AV-board solutions, with service and warranty extension packs also available.

faqs.question: Can GPSPL support audio for classrooms and training rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can support audio as part of smart classroom, hybrid learning, meeting-room and training-room technology environments.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL provide AMC for audio systems?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can support AMC and preventive maintenance planning depending on project scope, product category and site requirement.
